thread:
anya: Quick sync to lock v1 fallback ordering + autoscale gates for Dedicated. We need a minimal, predictable scope to ship.

mike: Proposed v1 surface: per-tenant configurable ordering, no cross-region moves. Fallback paths (v1): prewarm (paid) -> regional shared reserve -> quant/downscale variant.

sunil: Ops requirements: per-tenant soft caps on shared reserve, clear alerts, and an emergency rollback toggle (admin API + Console) before any canary.

greta: Product: default ordering must prefer paid prewarm. Expose a simple ordering editor in Console and a one-click "disable fallbacks (latency guarantee)" switch.

lia: Billing: we need every fallback request labeled (fallback=true, path=prewarm|reserve|downscale, tenant_id) so we can do dry-run billing exports. Also want hourly aggregates for pilot previews.

mike: Runtime notes: mapping table from canonical model -> compatible quant/downscale variants is required. Shared reserve needs admission control + per-tenant accounting. Will add a canary flag.

sunil: Telemetry: emit a fallback_event with tenant_id, request_id, original_model, fallback_path, added_latency_ms, tokens. Alert if SLA tenant fallback_rate > 0.5% over 5m or added_latency_avg > 100ms.

greta: Acceptance criteria (product): Console ordering editor + audit trail, default ordering applied for v1, dashboard tiles with fallback count/% and avg latency delta, per-tenant disable.

mike: Timeline estimate: mapping + telemetry = 2 sprints, shared reserve admission control = +1 sprint, Console UI = 1 sprint parallel. Canary: 72h with 3 pilot tenants.

anya: Risks/mitigations: quality regressions for quant downscale -> require model-owner opt-in for automatic downscale at GA and validation evals for pilots; noisy fallback chatter -> include response header `x-redwood-fallback` and an audit log entry for each event.

lia: Billing gating: dry-run CSV export must be available to pilots before GA; invoice line items for fallback tokens required.

anya: Action items: mike -> runtime spec + sample mapping (due Fri); sunil -> alert defs + runbook + dashboard mock (due Tue); greta -> Console UX + copy (due Tue); lia -> billing schema + dry-run plan (due Wed); anya -> recruit 3 pilots and prepare consent (due Mon). Locking scope for v1 if no objections.

mike: LGTM.

sunil: Ops OK but will block canary until alerts are wired.

greta: Product OK.

anya: Locking scope. I'll file tickets and follow up with PR links in #eng-runtime. Thanks everyone.
